mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_sensor_data (device_id, temperature, humidity) VALUES (#{deviceId}, #{temperature}, #{humidity})
mapper.select: SELECT id, device_id, temperature, humidity, create_time FROM t_sensor_data WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, device_id, temperature, humidity, create_time FROM t_sensor_data ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT device_id AS deviceId, MAX(create_time) AS lastTime, COUNT(*) AS count FROM t_sensor_data GROUP BY device_id

SELECT t.device_id AS deviceId, t.temperature AS temperature, t.humidity AS humidity, t.create_time AS lastTime FROM t_sensor_data t INNER JOIN ( SELECT device_id, MAX(create_time) AS max_time FROM t_sensor_data WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE) GROUP BY device_id ) latest ON t.device_id = latest.device_id AND t.create_time = latest.max_time
SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COUNT(DISTINCT device_id) AS deviceCount, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS todayCount FROM t_sensor_data
